unlatches.m: A form of unlatch, as in “she unlatches”. unlatch: remove from a latch.

unlatching.m: The act of unfastening a latch.

unlaying.m: The -ing form of unlay. unlay: to untwist.

unlays.m: A form of unlay, as in “she unlays”. unlay: to untwist.

unlicked.m: Newborn (of an animal), not yet licked into shape.

unlimber.m: To clumsily put into employ (a large weapon or object).

unlimbering.m: The -ing form of unlimber. unlimber: to clumsily put into employ (a large weapon or object).

unlimbers.m: A form of unlimber, as in “she unlimbers”. unlimber: to clumsily put into employ (a large weapon or object).

unlinking.m: The -ing form of unlink. unlink: to delete (a file).

unlinks.m: A form of unlink, as in “she unlinks”. unlink: to delete (a file).

unlistenable.m: Of a sound, quality, or characteristic, that a person cannot listen to for an extended time.

unloader.m: One who or that which unloads.

unloaders.m: More than one unloader. unloader: one who or that which unloads.
